engine_support.what: R4N3 (补查2 第 1 组 1a, 方块收割者 2.1.2 / 合成进化恐龙 3.5.0): the engine versions this Skill's parts and build steps are made for; cocos-game-to-english/scripts/check_machine.py --project reads the project's version against this table and prints the fixed route first. Patterns: 2.4.x = any 2.4 build, 3.x = any 3 build, 2.4.15 = that build only. A part's needs.engine_versions says where it can be installed; a part without needs follows its engine (2 -> 2.4.x, 3 -> supported 3.x)

routes.say: 原工程 {version} 不在支持表里（没有 TikTok 构建目标，也没有平台零件要用的 cc.assetManager）。固定路线：复制一份工程副本，用 Cocos Creator 2.4.15 打开副本升级（原工程一个文件都不动），之后都在副本上做，按 2.4.15 装零件；在 docs/english/engine.txt 写一行「原工程 {version}，副本升到 2.4.15 构建」。先做这一步，再做别的。
原工程 {version} 不在支持表里（3.x 零件只在 3.6～3.8 上测过）。固定路线：先装同一小版本的 Creator（{minor}.x），用它导出中文原版；英文版照下面的零件清单装，标「这个版本没测过」的零件首件构建后要先确认首页能进；首件进不去就复制副本升到 3.8.8 再做。先做这一步，再做别的。

engine_support.unsupported_say: 原工程 {version} 不在支持表里，也没有固定路线（支持 2.4.x 和 3.6～3.8）。先告诉用户这款用的引擎太老或太新，问要不要换一款，不要先改代码。

parts/PhysicsClock.js.origin: new in v7.8 (总表 P16): Cocos 2.4 only. At load and before every scene launch sets cc.director.getPhysicsManager().enabledAccumulator = true (fixed 1/60 s steps that follow real time); Clock.scale(dt) / Clock.force(v, dt) scale a push tuned at 60 fps. 全民飞车漂移 v3.1 steps physics 1/60 s per frame and pushes per call: 19.9 % farther at 1 s on a 120 Hz screen; with the accumulator and scaled pushes 1.05 % (runtime suite frame_rate). Node-tested (tests/physics-clock.test.js); 待真机复测
parts/PhysicsClock.js.use: tiktok_finalize source (step physics_clock) copies it to assets/tiktok-platform/PhysicsClock.js for a NEW 2.4 game whose scripts switch physics on without enabledAccumulator; legacy games are never given it. Not required by check_kit_project or K1/K2. The pushes stay the game's code (scale them by dt); the runtime suite frame_rate is the final judge
